revision_behaviour: Current-source revisions; historical tests use supplied 2026-09-19 snapshot. SAHMREALTIME retains its contemporary unemployment basis; other histories may revise. Historical release calendars unavailable; conservative lag in event study. Archive new observations prospectively.
what_it_is_for: How elevated are broad corporate profits relative to GDP, independently of per-share index earnings?
measured_base_rate: Not estimated: context indicator has no alarm/event claim (n=0 tested triggers).
false_positive_rate: Not applicable: no threshold fires; no false-positive denominator. It may not be promoted to a trigger without a preregistered event study.
independence: No validated full correlation matrix for this context measure; no equal-weight composite or independence claim. Equities/GDP and profit/GDP share the GDP denominator; headline and core CPI overlap.
action_it_informs: Context only, no action; inform long-horizon scenario discussion, never timing.
kill_criterion: Retire if consistent source disappears, accounting definition breaks without bridge, or 24 monthly audits show no distinct scenario information. No historical trigger skill claimed.
sampling_note: Operational values use latest available source observations; monthly derivations require completed periods. Historical performance uses monthly threshold crossings and coarse release lags, not every daily/weekly flag. Prospective scores use final acquired state in closed UTC months; exact publication times are unknown until separately captured.
